D'Arcy Short anchors the chase as Lumbini Lions clinch a thrilling 4-wicket victory over Karnali Yaks!
Karnali Yaks were put under pressure by Lumbini's bowling attack, but the Lions faced an early setback in the chase before D'Arcy Short steadied the innings with a composed knock.
Lumbini Lions held their nerve to chase down the target with 4 wickets to spare and 20 balls remaining, sealing a crucial win in Match 23!
